title: Dashboard
description: Demo overview of your property portfolio.

properties.label: Properties
properties.info: Number of properties provided by the demo data source.

units.label: Units
units.info: Total units attached to the properties shown. Value provided by the source, not recomputed.

rentDue.label: Rent due (month)
rentDue.info: Rent payable for the reference month. Distinct from rent received: the two are never conflated.

rentReceived.label: Rent received (month)
rentReceived.info: Amount actually received for the reference month. Missing data is not counted as zero.
rentReceived.missing: {count, plural, one {# property without received-rent data} other {# properties without received-rent data}}

rent.title: Rent due and received
rent.description: Monthly trend over 12 months, in Canadian dollars.
rent.info: Rent due (dashed line) and rent received (filled area) are two distinct measures. A month with no data stays empty.
rent.summary: Area chart: rent due and received per month over {count} months, from {from} to {to}.

units.title: Units per property
units.description: Number of units for each property.
units.summary: Horizontal bar chart: number of units for {count} properties.

types.title: Properties by type
types.summary: Donut chart: breakdown of {count} properties by type.
